description: NASA’s Earth Information Center (EIC) produces stunning visual telemetry of our changing planet, but visual data alone limits accessibility for visually impaired individuals and auditory learners. EarthHarmonics is an accessible, multi-sensory web synthesizer that translates temporal Earth science observations into dynamic, real-time auditory sonifications.
summary:
NASA’s Earth Information Center (EIC) produces stunning visual telemetry of our changing planet, but visual data alone limits accessibility for visually impaired individuals and auditory learners. EarthHarmonics is an accessible, multi-sensory web synthesizer that translates temporal Earth science observations into dynamic, real-time auditory sonifications.

Users explore five vital planetary health indicators spanning 1980 to 2026: Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (OCO-2 / Keeling Curve), Global Surface Temperature Anomalies (GISS GISTEMP), Arctic Sea Ice Minimum Extent (NSIDC / Cryosphere), Ocean Chlorophyll-a Biomass (MODIS-Aqua), and Wildfire Aerosol Optical Depth (VIIRS). The platform pairs scientific datasets with a polyphonic Web Audio API engine: pitch frequency reflects data magnitude, arpeggio tempo reflects rate of change, and harmonic timbre captures volatility. Featuring an interactive oscilloscope, frequency spectrum visualizer, and screen-reader transcriptions, EarthHarmonics makes global environmental trends tangible, engaging, and accessible to everyone.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

EarthHarmonics sonifies 46 years (1980–2026) of verified NASA Earth science datasets directly in the browser:

• Direct Pitch Mapping: As atmospheric CO2 climbs from 338 ppm to 426 ppm, the musical pitch rises from a deep 130 Hz cello tone to an 880 Hz soprano alarm.

• Harmonic Dissonance: Rising global temperature anomalies modulate dual sawtooth oscillators, introducing acoustic tension as warming exceeds +1.3°C.

• Crystalline Timbre to Sub-Bass Decay: As Arctic sea ice shrinks from 7.8M km² to 4.1M km², high-frequency bell chimes fade into low, hollow ambient bass.

• Web Audio API Synthesizer: Features 3 sound design themes (Cosmic Poly-Synth, Oceanic Ambient, Acoustic Marimba) with tempo control (1x, 2x, 4x warp).

• Real-Time Audio Canvas Visualizer: Displays real-time time-domain waveforms and 128-band FFT frequency spectrum bars.

• Universal Accessibility: Displays live transcripts with frequency (Hz) and numerical values for assistive screen readers.

2. BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

Breaks down visual barriers in climate communication. Provides visually impaired scientists, educators, and students with an intuitive auditory window into NASA's planetary data.

3. TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and the Web Audio API (OscillatorNode, BiquadFilterNode, AnalyserNode, GainNode). Zero external sound libraries or server dependencies.

4. CREATIVITY & INNOVATION

Translates scientific rates of change (derivatives) into musical rhythm and acceleration, allowing listeners to literally hear when climate trends speed up.

5. FACTORS CONSIDERED

Ensured accurate linear and logarithmic acoustic frequency scaling so that sound pitch authentically reflects published NASA Earth data rather than arbitrary noise.
